name: Genesis
tagline: A generative, ultra-fast physics platform for robotics and embodied AI.
description: An open-source simulation platform for general-purpose robotics and embodied-AI learning, rebuilt from the ground up in pure Python. Combines a unified multi-physics engine, a photorealistic renderer, and a generative data engine that turns natural-language prompts into simulation scenes and training data.
insight: Began as a Dec 2024 academic project; its backer Genesis AI left stealth in July 2025 with a $105M seed co-led by Eclipse and Khosla.

modelSupport.notes: A physics/simulation platform, not an LLM app; pairs with any robot-learning policy.

edge: Pure-Python robotics simulator that is far quicker to set up than classic engines, with built-in photorealistic rendering and generative scene/data tooling.
pros: Unifies rigid, soft, and fluid physics
cons: Generative data engine still rolling out

references.title: Khosla-backed robotics startup Genesis AI has gone full stack
Genesis AI emerges from stealth with $105M seed funding
